thread:
maya: Quick sync — where are the phoenix-3b weights currently staged? onboarding CI is failing and the tokenizer seems to drop leading spaces in the structured-output tests.
arjun: Uploaded to s3://redwood-models/phoenix/phoenix-3b/v1/ (private). Use the redwood-ml-service role. I also opened a tiny fix in PR #3421 for s3 path normalization.
samir: @maya can you paste the exact validation error you saw? I ran into tokenization oddness while testing tool-call JSONs earlier.
maya: Error block:
```
ValidationError: config.validate failed
  - tokenizer returned uneven tokenization for sample 12
  - missing special_tokens['bos'] in tokenizer config
  - model weights manifest: vocab_hash mismatch (expected abc123, got abd124)
```
Also we see outputs like " \" tool_call\": {\"name\":\"calc\" ...}" (extra leading space in key), which breaks our parsers.
pri: Ran the golden prompts locally. Structured-output-checker failed 12/50 cases. Most failures are tool_call arg ordering and trailing commas in streaming output.
dave: Quick smoke command you can run:
```
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model phoenix-3b --goldens=golden_tool_calls.json --out=/tmp/phoenix-smoke.json
```
That will run the smoke suite against staging.
arjun: PR #3421 fixes the s3 path issue and seeds default tokenizer special tokens if missing. @pri @dave can you skim? It's small.
maya: Minimal repro (staging):
```
curl -s -X POST http://staging.redwood.internal/serve/v1/generate \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"phoenix-3b","input":"Call the tool to add 2 and 3"}'
```
Response snippet:
```
{"id":"...","output":"{\\n  \\\"tool_call\\\": { \\\"name\\\": \\\"calc\\\", \\\"args\\\": [ 2,3 ] }\\n}"}
```
Note the space before `tool_call` and inconsistent args order.
deploy-bot: deploy started for staging/phoenix-3b:v1 — 3/5 nodes up, healthcheck failing: tokenizer-init error on node-2.
samir: node-2 logs:
```
[ERR] Tokenizer load error: Unknown special token: '<|pad|>'
[WARN] vocab version mismatch: manifest.vocab_version=2026-01-22, weights.vocab_version=2025-11-07
```
Looks like mixed vocab files in the bundle.
maya: Likely cause: tokenizer.json in the bundle got overwritten by an older version during packaging. Check the weights manifest `manifest.json` for `vocab_version` and ensure tokenizer files come from the same build.
pri: Temporary workaround: add this to the serving config for staging until we rebuild the bundle:
```
tokenizer_overrides:
  add_prefix_space: true
  special_tokens:
    bos: "<|bos|>"
    eos: "<|eos|>"
```
That buys us time, but we need a proper fix in the tokenizer packaging.
dave: I'm OOO after 16:00 PT. @arjun @samir can you own the immediate roll-forward? I'll review the PR in the morning.
arjun: I'll take the rollout. Plan: 1) pin weights to s3 path we just uploaded, 2) rebuild tokenizer bundle from the 2026-01-22 artifacts, 3) run the golden-tool-call regression (add assert that json.loads succeeds and args ordering matches canonical ordering).
maya: Also please create a canary route `phoenix-3b:v1-canary` and route 5% traffic so we can run the full golden set against live inference without impacting prod.
pri: :thumbsup: once canary is up I'll run the regression suite and report fails in this thread. Will add a small test in the eval harness to catch leading-space keys.
arjun: tagging checklist for myself: update manifest, bump model version to v1.0.1, add regression test in infra/goldens, merge PR, trigger canary deploy.
maya: Thanks team. If anyone finds additional mismatches, drop logs here or @maya directly.
